## Image Loader 0.6.0

This release adds the first real screenshot-to-schematic workflow and finishes the Gallery/visibility work.

### Added

- Schematic Mode ON/OFF toggle.
- Vanilla tile-texture recognition for native Terraria screenshots.
- Confidence-based background rejection for schematic cells.
- Persistent Gallery zoom HUD.
- Zoom-aware tile and wall drawing bounds.
- Detailed installation, usage, compatibility, and troubleshooting documentation.

### Changed

- Gallery zoom no longer sends a chat message for every wheel step.
- Schematic conversion now uses actual texture profiles instead of only dividing the screenshot size and matching average colours.
- The mod version is now 0.6.0.

### Existing 0.5-series features included

- URL loading and transparency preview.
- Vanilla and Exact RGB placement.
- Exact RGB map/minimap rendering.
- Fullbright image tiles.
- Gallery noclip and Ctrl + wheel zoom.
- Void Gallery world generation.
- Server-authoritative multiplayer placement.

### Compatibility

Built and compiled against Terraria 1.4.4.9 with the tModLoader 2026.08 preview line. Use the attached `.tmod` only with its matching loader line, or build the source against another compatible Terraria 1.4.4 tModLoader installation.

### Schematic limitation

A screenshot cannot encode hidden wall, wire, liquid, paint, slope, actuator, or multi-tile origin data. Version 0.6.0 recognizes safe single-tile solid vanilla blocks and deliberately skips uncertain cells.
